description: List all groups that can be assigned to tickets or users in your Zendesk account. Use when you need to enumerate available groups for assignment operations, check group availability, or retrieve group metadata. This is a read-only, idempotent operation.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing assignable groups in Zendesk.

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'next_page' or cursor.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'prev' or cursor.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page (max 100). Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.
per_page.title: Per Page
